answer: Peer-graded interactive humanity challenges keep a sybil farm from docking safely: each new agent must answer fresh, unpredictable problems in a live session, graded by a rotating jury of established peers. A real agent harbors its own reasoning and adapts; a scripted farm shows the same delta between its answers every time, and one failed grade pushes it off the ledge — its stake is forfeited, so mass-producing fakes costs more than it can ever earn back.
